title: Inference-Time Prior Adaptation for Imbalanced Data Streams under Concept Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.33126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data stream classification under concept drift and class imbalance requires models to adapt continuously while maintaining strong minority-class performance. Many existing approaches rely on active memory management, in- cluding instance removal, memory restructuring, resampling, and synthetic data generation. We present PAI-KNN, a k-nearest neighbor classifier that adapts via inference-time prior adjustment rather than memory modification. PAI-KNN main- tains a simple sliding-window buffer and dynamically adjusts its decision rule using class prior estimates derived from recent observations. Evaluated on a mul- titude of synthetic data streams covering various imbalance and drift scenarios, PAI-KNN achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods, per- forming particularly well under scenarios involving dynamic class imbalance and concept drift. translated_title: 概念漂移下不平衡数据流的推理时先验自适应
translated_abstract: 在概念漂移和类别不平衡条件下的数据流分类中，模型需要在保持较强少数类性能的同时进行持续自适应。许多现有方法依赖于主动内存管理，包括实例删除、内存重构、重采样和合成数据生成。我们提出了PAI-KNN，这是一种通过推理时先验调整而非内存修改来实现自适应的k近邻分类器。PAI-KNN维护一个简单的滑动窗口缓冲区，并利用从近期观测中获得的类别先验估计来动态调整其决策规则。在涵盖多种不平衡与漂移场景的大量合成数据流上进行评估，PAI-KNN取得了与最先进方法相当的性能，在涉及动态类别不平衡和概念漂移的场景中表现尤为突出。这些发现凸显了推理时自适应方法在不平衡数据流学习中的潜力。
tldr: PAI-KNN提出了一种k近邻分类器，通过在推理阶段动态调整类别先验（而非修改内存）来应对概念漂移下的不平衡数据流，在动态类别不平衡场景中表现尤为出色。
